caption: The drawing depicts a young boy with short, light brown or blond hair dressed in a formal outfit. He is wearing a black velvet jacket and matching black velvet knee-length pants. Under the jacket, he has a white shirt with a high lace collar and a large black bow tied at the neck. The shirt features a vertical line of lace running down the center. The boy's shoes are light brown with black buttons on the sides. He stands on a rectangular mat that is shaded light gray in the center and surrounded by a mauve-brown border. The background of the image is plain and beige. The name "Eugene Croe" is handwritten in purple ink in the bottom right corner.
title: Boy Doll
